Welcome! I am an applied Data Scientist with 2+ years of hands-on experience in building machine learning pipelines, time-series forecasting engines, and production MLOps workflows.

Currently, I work as a **Data Scientist Associate at Trinity Mobility**, designing intelligent IoT pipelines, energy demand simulation engines, and smart municipal alert services.

## About this blog

This repository and blog is my open technical journal where I document:

- End-to-end reproducible Jupyter notebooks converted into interactive web articles
- Practical experiments across Statistics, Time Series, Gen AI, RAG, and Agentic AI
- Deep dives into algorithmic concepts, performance tuning, and system architecture

Start with a [learning track](index.qmd#roadmap), browse [all articles](articles.qmd), or check out the code on [GitHub](https://github.com/alekha1234/blog).
